title: Rename one stable Client without rewriting identity or frozen history

requirements.invariant: A rename targets one existing stable ClientID in one immutable Account and supplies one validated current display name. It cannot change Client identity, infer identity from text, merge Clients, reassign a Project or use copied project.clientName as authority.

The rename intent changes only the Client's current display value. Later authoritative current Project projections resolve that display by ClientID, while frozen Invoice, report, paid-history and audit snapshots are not payload members and must never be rewritten by this command.

RenameClient is distinct from CreateClient, ArchiveClient, ChangeProjectClient and MergeClients. The command carries no lifecycle, child, accounting, history, merge, alias or reassignment input, so O-024/O-025 remain open and unchanged.

The rename payload is bound to exactly one OperationID, contract version, AccountID, actor PrincipalID, finite capture time, stable Client subject and same-subject expected revision through the shared fingerprint/receipt lifecycle. It defines no competing queue, retry, rejection or result semantics.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: One narrow backend-neutral Client rename operation accepts the validated typed command and returns the shared OperationReceipt or a stable failure. Local validation never substitutes for trusted later membership/capability authorization, revision enforcement or history-safe authoritative apply.

This Phase 1 command boundary is executable only with deterministic provider-free evidence while the shipped app remains unchanged and no Client table/row, handler, RLS policy, Sync Stream, Auth/provider choice, source transform, hosted resource or production authority is introduced.

items: ExpectedClientRevision is one exact unsigned revision. ClientRenameDraft owns exact Account, actor, operation-contract, stable Client, validated replacement display name, expected revision and finite capture time; it contains no Project/clientName/history/lifecycle/correction input.

RenameClientPayload contains only stable ClientID and ClientDisplayName. RenameClientCommand binds it to the shared OperationEnvelope, derives the exact Client subject, requires exactly one same-subject expected-revision precondition and revalidates payload, subject, precondition and fingerprint on decode.

ClientRenaming is the narrow backend-neutral operation port returning the shared OperationReceipt. Command receipt validation requires the exact OperationID and exposes no authoritative Client-row or projection result claim.

ClientRenameFailure exposes stable bounded time, binding, revision-precondition, subject, fingerprint, receipt, local-acceptance and malformed-encoding codes while reusing the verified ClientDisplayName and shared operation validators.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This Phase 1 contract creates or changes no clients table, name/revision/audit column, Account foreign key, constraint, index, view, trigger or migration.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No authoritative RenameClient handler, membership/capability check, revision lock, projection update, audit event, idempotency result or history-preservation transaction exists.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API and no grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Typed Account/actor/Client binding is not authorization. No membership predicate, financial-visibility decision, grant, USING/WITH CHECK policy or cross-tenant database test exists.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, local Client table, optimistic rename projection, upload connector, conflict restoration or synchronized current-Project display claim is defined.

items: The complete command is canonical Codable evidence over draft, shared envelope, Client subject and fingerprint; decode reconstructs through the same validators and byte-identical structured restart is required.
Changed Account, actor, contract, Client, name, revision, subject, preconditions, fingerprint or receipt OperationID fails atomically without rebinding identity or returning a partial command.

A deterministic reference adapter may accept the command into the shared OperationJournal and prove exact replay/receipt semantics; this is not physical durable-store, process/device restart, optimistic Client display or authoritative server apply evidence.

storageMedia.notApplicable: Client rename owns no attachment bytes, reference, local media receipt, upload, retention, deletion or presentation behavior.

appMcp.notApplicable: No Client editor, current Project display, current app service, MCP tool/schema, transport, contract-catalog entry or app/MCP parity claim is wired.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase project.clientName is decoded, propagated or rewritten and no source Client/display snapshot is transformed. Later migration must preserve frozen names and resolve current Client identity separately.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failures are contract values only; no signal emission, metric, alert, audit sink or runbook action is introduced.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and its tests and does not change or link either application project.

The slice cannot rename a visible or authoritative Client, update Project projections, rewrite frozen history, authorize membership, archive/merge Clients, reassign Projects, define provider/schema/migration behavior, activate a feature, deploy, release or cut over.

verification.expected: A valid synthetic draft produces one typed exact-scope RenameClient command with one same-subject expected revision; the payload contains only stable Client identity and validated new display text and cannot carry Project, archive, merge, alias, reassignment or frozen-history input.

Representative rename commands round-trip byte-identically with exact Account/actor/contract/Operation/Client/name/revision/time/subject/fingerprint evidence and no backend path, provider, credential, Project projection or server-result claim.

Blank display text, invalid time and changed Account/actor/contract/Client/name/revision/payload/subject/preconditions/fingerprint/receipt evidence fail atomically through existing or Client-rename stable diagnostic codes.

A deterministic reference port returns the shared queued receipt, exact replay returns the same receipt, the same OperationID with changed Client/name/revision is refused by the shared lifecycle, and a failing port returns no success receipt.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both target builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming Client row/projection, server, authorization, provider, migration or production behavior.

notes: Decision-independent Phase 1 command boundary only. D-006 and the canonical Client lifecycle settle stable identity and rename semantics. O-024/O-025 remain fully open because no archive/delete/merge/reassignment behavior exists. The slice stops before physical durable storage, authoritative Client/Project projection, server apply, schema/RLS/Sync/Auth/provider, app/MCP, source migration, hosted resources, production access or cutover.
